title: LLM Gateway with Fallback Adapter
instructions: Build `llm_gateway.py`: make `ChatRequest` and `ChatReply` frozen slotted dataclasses, write `AcmeAdapter` (provider "acme") and `NimbusAdapter` (provider "nimbus") that normalise request, reply, token counts and `ConnectionError`/`TimeoutError` into `ModelUnavailable` (chained with `from`), and `FallbackChatModel`, itself a `ChatModel`, that tries models in order. The vendor clients in `vendors.py` are provided.

evidence.label: ChatRequest and ChatReply are frozen slotted dataclasses with a 256 default
AcmeAdapter maps request, reply and token counts
NimbusAdapter maps request, reply and token counts
Connection and timeout errors become ModelUnavailable with __cause__ kept
Adapters do not swallow programming errors
Falls back to the second provider with correct token mapping
Returns the first success without calling later models
All failing raises ModelUnavailable chained to the last failure
A KeyError from a model propagates and stops the chain
Rejects an empty list and composes like any ChatModel
